worldcombat.skill.naturepower.summary: Call up the ground beneath you into a ground-hugging ley line that races at the target and sweeps every foe along its path once: plants paralyse, fire burns and sets alight, earth shatters armour; every ground shoves the target along the line, with water pushing furthest, and open air leaves only a plain impact. Changing the ground changes what the move does.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.use.0: Let the ground choose the type
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.descriptio: Race along the ground toward the target as a ground-hugging ley line for about %1$s special damage; its type follows the ground under the caster: plants to Grass, water/ice/snow to Water, fire/lava to Fire, other solid blocks to Rock, and air or void to Normal.

The ley line reaches %1$s blocks with a half-width of %2$s blocks, sweeping every enemy along its path once (a given enemy is hit only once). On a hit that deals damage: plant ground has a %3$s chance to paralyse the target - for 40 s, halving its movement speed and giving each of its actions a 25%% chance to fail; Electric-types are immune. Fire ground sets the target alight for 3 s and has a %3$s chance to burn it - for 40 s, losing 1/16 of its maximum health every 5 s (at least 1) and dealing half physical damage; Fire-types are immune.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.stance.cha: Charged ley line: the wind-up stretches to %1$s for x1.25 power and +2 blocks of reach, good for heavy hits at range.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.stance.qui: Quick call: a very short wind-up at base power and reach, good for close fighting.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.timing: A targeted surge move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.preference: On: about 6 more ticks of wind-up (still clamped by speed) for x1.25 power and +2 blocks of reach. Off: a very short wind-up at base power and reach. Each side has its own situations.
Only attack within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
When on, a stationed companion also leaves its post to cast; when off it stays put.
worldcombat.skill.naturepower.descriptio: On a hit that deals damage, the target is also shoved along the ley line's direction: base knockback %1$s blocks, scaled by the ground - water x1.6, earth x1.0, plain x0.7, plants x0.55, fire x0.5. Earth ground additionally lowers the target's Defence by one stage.
